title: Deals: Google’s Pixel 11 series gets price cuts, Samsung Galaxy Z8 foldables discounted
description: The Google Pixel 11 series is currently available at a discount, along with last year’s Pixel 10 Pro. Samsung’s latest Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Galaxy Z Fold8, and Galaxy Z Flip8 are also on sale. Meanwhile, Xiaomi’s 17 series and 17T lineup are available at discounted prices as well. The Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL are available with discounts, although the deals are limited to the 256GB variants. Notably, the Pixel 11 Pro deal is part of a bundle that includes a pair of Pixel Buds Pro 2 at no extra cost. ...

title: Weekly poll: what do you think of the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max?
description: Hot on the heels of the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and 8 Elite Gen 6 announcement, Xiaomi unveiled two flagships featuring the new chips. These two are already on sale in China and Xiaomi has confirmed that the Xiaomi 18 Pro series will be available globally. “When?” and “How much?” are questions for another date. We wanted to get your first reaction to the new models – do you like the direction in which Xiaomi is taking its flagship series? Would you buy one and which one? Let’s do a quick introduction – the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max is the big 6.9” flagship. It gets the “Extreme”...

title: Weekly poll results: the Redmi Note 17 Pro and Note 17 Pro Max feel like a step back
description: While they were not universally loved, the Redmi Note 15 series from Xiaomi got a positive response in a poll a year ago. The Pro+ model was clearly the fan favorite, but the Pro did well for itself too. Last week we polled your opinion on their successors – and the results aren’t nearly as good. To summarize the results, the Redmi Note 17 Pro Max is overpriced. The regular 17 Pro is also overpriced – and people would rather have the Pro Max, anyway. Sticking to the Redmi Note 17 Pro Max for now, it found some fans, but most would-be buyers are put off by the price. The price hike...

title: WhatsApp is redesigning its Android app, here's how
description: WhatsApp is currently in the process of redesigning its Android app, according to a new report. The redesign is right now focused on the app’s navigation bar, which is getting a new look and a new item inside of it. The image below shows the rough state of the current development - this is definitely not the final version of the redesign, since the Meta AI button appears in two different places. title: Apple code confirms the main specs of the next entry-level iPad
description: Apple launched its latest entry-level iPad in March 2025, and its successor has been expected to arrive about two years after that in spring 2027. Ahead of that, a new report brings us the upcoming tablet's main specs, courtesy of "details found in Apple's code". So, the next entry-level iPad will be powered by the A19 chip, paired with 8GB of RAM. That's a solid upgrade over the existing model's A16 chip and 6GB of RAM. Not just that, but Apple Intelligence support is a given on the new device, along with the new Siri AI. The existing 2025 entry-level iPad The new tablet will also...

title: Deals: Galaxy Z Fold7 vs. Galaxy Z Fold8 and Z Fold8 Ultra, plus Galaxy S26 FE alternatives
description: Last week, we focused on the iPhone 18 Pro series launch. This week we’ll have a look at what has been going on with Galaxy phones. Let’s start with the foldables. The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold7 – last year’s book-style foldable – is available for $1,350. This is $550 less than what its replacement costs, the Z Fold8 Ultra. Both are surprisingly thin (8.9mm) and light (215g) for foldables, but the new one brings a tangible increase in battery size – 600mAh over the 4,400mAh battery of the Z Fold7. And it increases both wired (25W to 45W) and wireless (15W to 20W) charging. The other major...

title: Here's the Apple HomePod Mini 2 in all its colors
description: Apple unveiled the first HomePod Mini in October 2020. It was initially offered in white and midnight, then later in blue, orange, and yellow. Now, an image of the yet-to-be-launched HomePod Mini 2, shared by MacRumors, shows the speaker in all its colors. The image below shows the HomePod Mini 2 in five colors: pink, white, green, blue, and midnight. Pink and green are new colors, while the blue shade is slightly lighter than the original HomePod Mini's. title: Here are some more renders of the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ and Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra
description: Samsung was expected to unveil the Galaxy Tab S12+ and Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra this month, but rumors now suggest it will make these tablets official next month - October 7, to be precise. Leaked renders of both tablets revealed their designs, so we already know what they would look like. Now a new set of renders has surfaced, corroborating earlier design leaks. The Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra has a notched display and two rear cameras. title: Oppo gives us our best look yet at the upcoming K14 Plus, confirms memory options
description: Oppo recently announced that it would unveil the K14 Plus in India on September 29, with online retailer Flipkart revealing its design, color options, and key specs. Now, Oppo has set up a page on its Indian website and shared images of the K14 Plus, giving us our best look at it yet. The Oppo K14 Plus' white model is called Star White, and the orange version is called Solar Orange. Both have the same patterns on their back covers, along with text in the right corner that reads "Stay Cool. Stay Powered." title: Deals: massive price cuts for the Galaxy Z Fold8 and Z Flip8, Pixel 11 series also discounted
description: The Galaxy Z Fold8 and Z Flip8 are around one-third off this week – these are massive discounts for cutting-edge foldables that only launched last month. The big Z Fold8 Ultra along with the Pixel 11 series has smaller discounts that are still worth a look. The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 is down to €1,430 for the base 12/256GB unit. The upgrade to 512GB storage is quite pricey at the moment despite a fairly decent discount on it. title: Honor keeps teasing the Magic9 Pro Max's cinematic mic and teleconverter
description: Honor is unveiling the Magic9 series on September 28, and since we're just a few days away from the event, the company keeps on teasing the upcoming phones. The Magic9 devices, or at least the Magic9 Pro Max, will feature a cinematic mic, and Honor's "imaging innovator" Han Han has shared how it delivers a dynamic sound experience in his daily life. This cinematic mic captures sounds from both near and far - and every sound is crystal clear, be it of fried food or a coffee machine or some clothes flapping in the distance. title: Here's proof the vivo X500 Pro Max is a cameraphone to be reckoned with
description: We had the distinct pleasure of attending vivo's X500 series unveiling in Shanghai, China. If you've never been to such an event, it's pretty nice; the maker usually arranges a bunch of photo opportunities around the location, and vivo did just that. So we went to a couple of places, vivo X500 Pro Max in hand, and took some photos. We did share a bunch of these pics with you in our hands-on, but we had more, so we're sharing them as well. description: Motorola has started rolling out the update to Android 17 for the Edge 60 Fusion in India, according to reports on Reddit. description: A US-based company called Ioengine is suing Samsung in the US District Court for the Eastern District of Texas, alleging that the Korean company is using five of its connectivity-related patents without authorization or compensation. These patents were allegedly used by Samsung in the Galaxy S23 Ultra, Galaxy Watch Ultra, Galaxy Buds2 Pro, and Samsung's Portable SSD T7. These devices are being used as examples, by the way - they do not represent the full scope of the complaint. title: Qualcomm may be adding DirectX 12 support on its flagship Snapdragon chips
description: Qualcomm is apparently considering an official solution to better support PC game emulation on Android. According to one Chinese YouTuber, the company may be adding proper support for DirectX 12 for its Snapdragon chips. If this happens, it would make emulating PC games on Android much easier. The YouTuber in question tested the capability on a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 reference device and managed to successfully run Cyberpunk 2077 and Black Myth: Wukong through a translation layer in DirectX 12 mode. title: Multiple users report lockscreen issues after installing the September Pixel Drop
description: The September Pixel Drop brought improvements to the VIP contacts widget, shored up scam detection and added the Pause Point feature to older models. And it seems that it also introduced a nasty bug to the lockscreen. One Reddit user reports that they couldn’t get through the pattern lock on their lockscreen Pixel 10 Pro XL – they couldn’t even connect the second dot of the pattern before the screen would reset. Another 10 Pro XL user in the same thread experienced similar issues but managed to find a workaround – hard restarting the phone by holding the Power and Volume Down buttons. The...

title: Insta360 may be working on a unique pair of AI-powered smart glasses
description: According to a new report from China, Insta360 is now working on a pair of AI-powered smart glasses. This apparently comes from sources close to the company. No actual details about the glasses have been revealed thus far, but Insta360 does hold a patent for "wearable glasses", which could potentially give us some hints. In that patent, Insta360 describes a pair of smart glasses that don't have a built-in battery. Instead, the battery is separate and intended to be worn on another part of the body. title: Infinix unveils GT NX Controller and GT NX Station dock
description: Infinix has now launched the GT NX Controller and the GT NX Station. The former is designed to be able to replicate "the nuanced precision" of touchscreen operation, featuring "the world's first Pixel-Level FPS Precision Touchpad" in a mobile gaming controller, delivering "mouse-like accuracy for mobile FPS titles". The GT NX Controller has an "esports-grade" three-chip low-latency architecture with "millisecond-level" Direct Connect. title: vivo S2 FE's launch date and design revealed by online retailer
description: A recent rumor claimed that vivo would launch the S2 FE on October 6 alongside the V80. While vivo is yet to say anything about the S2 FE, Indian online retailer Flipkart has set up a promo page on its website, confirming the smartphone's October 6 unveiling. Flipkart has also shared an image on the page, revealing the vivo S2 FE's design. The smartphone features a green-colored back panel with a camera island housing two cameras.
